intro: Make every meal a memory. Our Bliss dining table brings rustic elegance and room for all, wrapped in rich walnut tones and crafted with care from solid Sheesham wood.

features.title: Where elegance meets earth
features.text: The fine walnut finish and rustic grain patterns bring natural beauty and warmth to your dining space.

features.title: Simple care, lasting beauty
features.text: Easy to clean and even easier to love—just a quick wipe over natural wood grains keeps your rustic charm table looking fresh every day.

features.title: Strong from the inside out
features.text: Crafted from seasoned, termite-resistant Dura-wood, your table is built to last through every season and celebration.

features.title: Design that stands out
features.text: The bold criss-cross leg pattern adds a sculptural touch to your space, blending form and function.

features.title: Made to gather
features.text: With generous space for eight, your table invites connection—whether it's cozy breakfasts or big celebrations.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Bliss V2 8-Seater Solid Wood Rectangular Dining Table
